name: TIMEOUT_EXCLUSIVE_NONSHARED_CPU_TRANSFER

cohort_rules.NON_SHARED_JOB: exclusive CPU partition AND (shared_job_count IS NULL OR shared_job_count = 0)

where_sql: state_simple='TIMEOUT' AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND duration_s > 0 AND wallclock_used_s > 0 AND nodes_used > 0 AND processors_used > 0 AND energy_wh IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(energy_wh) AND energy_wh > 0 AND hardware_branch='CPU' AND partition IN ('bigmem','bigmem-stdby','bigmeml','bigmeml-stdby','debug','debug-stdby','hbw','hbw-stdby','hbwl','long','long-stdby','medmem','medmem-stdby','nvme','short','short-stdby','standard','standard-stdby') AND (shared_job_count IS NULL OR shared_job_count = 0) AND nodes_req > 0 AND processors_req > 0 AND wallclock_req_s > 0

interpretation_rule_predeclared.PASS_TRANSFER: Frozen coefficient remains reasonably calibrated: aggregate |bias| comparable to completed test (~few percent) AND WAPE not many-fold worse AND W/node-hour distribution concentrated near p_frozen.
interpretation_rule_predeclared.PARTIAL_TRANSFER: Same order/structure (median W/node-hour near p_frozen; log R2 still high) but meaningful systematic state bias or WAPE inflation.
interpretation_rule_predeclared.FAIL_TRANSFER: State materially alters the node-hour relationship or energy semantics (median W/node-hour far from p_frozen, or huge bias, or energy not occupancy-like).

anchors.event: Campus construction requires a full ESIF power outage; HPC data center unavailable June 26 through June 30; all HPC systems including Kestrel shut down; targeted return end of day July 3.
anchors.expected_it_meter: IT power should collapse during the power-outage calendar days and recover around July 3.
anchors.clock: Announcement uses calendar dates without an hour; treat as America/Denver civil dates. Do not lag-optimize.

anchors.source: NLR HPC announcement 'Kestrel Planned Outage and Phase II GPU Integration' (Jan 12, 2024)
anchors.event: Kestrel offline Monday January 29th at 7:00 AM through Friday February 9th (login, filesystems, compute).
anchors.expected_it_meter: Kestrel job replay ~0; ESIF IT may remain elevated because Eagle still occupied the floor until 2024-06-15.
anchors.clock: 7:00 AM is operational local time at NLR Golden (Mountain).
